meta.name: hunt-cloud-misconfig
meta.description: Hunt cloud / infrastructure misconfigurations. AWS: public S3 buckets (s3:GetObject anonymous), permissive bucket policies (PutObjectAcl public-write), exposed CloudFront origin, public Lambda function URL, public RDS snapshot, IAM credentials in JS bundles, AWS metadata accessible via SSRF. GCP: public GCS buckets, exposed Cloud Run services, leaked service account JSON. Azure: public blob containers, exposed Function App. (Kubernetes/Docker exposure is owned by hunt-k8s; CI/CD pipeline attacks by hunt-cicd; post-credential IAM escalation by cloud-iam-deep.) Detection: targeted dorking, certificate transparency, JS bundle secret extraction, port scan for known service ports. Validate: actual data read / write / RCE. Use when hunting cloud-native storage and compute misconfig (S3/GCS/Blob, IMDS-via-SSRF, serverless, public managed services).

copy.tagline: 扫描云服务中的错误配置与暴露风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你负责云基础设施安全，需要发现并验证配置漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Scan cloud services for misconfigurations and exposure risks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage cloud infrastructure security and need to find and validate configuration vulnerabilities.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会检查 AWS、GCP、Azure 的云服务配置，寻找公开的存储桶、暴露的 Lambda 函数 URL、可读的 RDS 快照、IAM 凭据泄露等安全问题，并验证能否实际读写数据。
howto.when: 当你要求检查云服务（如 S3、GCS、Azure Blob）是否存在配置错误，或发现可疑的公开资源时触发。

say.text: 检查这个 S3 存储桶是否允许匿名访问。
say.note: Claude 会尝试列出桶内容并检查权限。

say.text: 扫描这个网站，看看有没有泄露的 AWS 密钥。
say.note: Claude 会搜索 JS 文件中的 IAM 凭据。

say.text: 验证这个 CloudFront 源站是否暴露。
say.note: Claude 会测试源站是否可直接访问。

howto.what_en: Claude checks AWS, GCP, and Azure cloud services for misconfigurations like public buckets, exposed Lambda URLs, readable RDS snapshots, leaked IAM credentials, and validates actual data read/write access.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to check cloud services (e.g., S3, GCS, Azure Blob) for misconfigurations or when suspicious public resources are found.

say_en.text: Check if this S3 bucket allows anonymous access.
say_en.note: Claude will try to list bucket contents and check permissions.

say_en.text: Scan this website for leaked AWS keys.
say_en.note: Claude will search JS files for IAM credentials.

say_en.text: Verify if this CloudFront origin is exposed.
say_en.note: Claude will test direct access to the origin.
